title: Write a responsible AI-assistant use guide for learning teams
description: The approved /resources approach promises an article about what an AI assistant should and should not handle. Write a publish-ready, scenario-based guide for educators: helpful drafting and summarizing tasks, human review, student privacy, uncertainty, and when staff must decide. Verify any claimed Zedu AI feature in current product copy; do not invent safeguards or guarantees. Deliver a title under 60 characters, description under 160, structured article, three FAQs, and exact links to the relevant product and policy pages. This is an editorial guide, separate from the three audience-operations guides.
reviewBlocker: The task has no delivery waiting for review.
